name: Skarner
title: the Primordial Sovereign

Q.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
Q.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and dealing 10/20/30/40/50 + 0.9×bonus AD + 0.03×bonus max HP physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional 11% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by 40% for 1s. Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing @spell.SkarnerQ:AbilityDamage@ + @spell.SkarnerQ:MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowPercent*100@% for @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowDuration(varies)SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@
Q.summary: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

W.name: Seismic Bastion
W.description: Skarner gains 0.08×max HP Shield for 2.5s and triggers an earthquake that deals 50/70/90/110/130 + 0.8×AP magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 1s.
W.summary: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

E.name: Ixtal's Impact
E.description: Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals 30/60/90/120/150 + 1.2×bonus AD + 0.06×max HP physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for 1.1s. Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.
E.summary: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

R.name: Impale
R.description: Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing 150/250/350 + 1×AP magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for 1.5s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability. If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains 40% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.
R.summary: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

Passive.name: Threads of Vibration
Passive.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.
Passive.summary: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tank jungler/top laner who drags enemies with an E charge into walls for a stun and suppresses up to three champions with R. Strong ganker and teamfight catcher.
strengths: E charge ignores terrain: carry a target into a wall for a stun
R suppresses up to three champions and drags them
Q boulder empowers attacks with max-health damage and a slow, or throws it
Passive Quaking: max-health damage on stacked targets
weaknesses: E needs good angles; a mis-aimed E is a wasted engage
Low burst: a tank, not a killer
Kited when E and R are down

curve.lvl2: medium – Q + W clear; no wall-stun yet
curve.items: medium – tank items (Heartsteel or Sunfire Aegis) add max-health scaling to Q and passive

profile.curveNote: Ganks from level 3 with E; R makes him a pick tool.

Passive.notes: Quaking stacks from attacks/Q/R; max stacks = max-health damage over time.

Q.notes: Empowers next 3 attacks; last slows. Recast throws the boulder (projectile).

E.notes: Charge drags a champion; wall collision stuns.

R.notes: Suppresses first 3 champions hit and drags them.

profile.windowAgainst: E and R down: he has no catch tool. Stay away from walls when he charges.
checks: E drag: is it a pull (airborne)? Treated as stun only on wall collision.
